source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper states full recovery of the DAG from the joint Gaussian distribution under equal error variances.

source_verification_receipts.version: public preprint corresponding to IEEE JSAIT 4 (2023), 639–650
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper formulates partial homoscedasticity through a supplied partition into blocks sharing error variances, characterizes resulting equivalence, and constructs a CPDAG representation.
The paper studies coloured Gaussian DAG submodels defined by partial homogeneity constraints on error variances and structural coefficients.
The paper studies unrestricted edge-labelled graph problems and reports W[2]-hardness in the number of used labels, including bounded-pathwidth cases.
The paper introduces primal-pathwidth SETH and studies base-improvement barriers for pathwidth dynamic programs.
The paper gives test-inversion confidence regions for total causal effects accounting for graph-structure uncertainty under equal error variances.
The paper constructs asymptotically valid confidence sets for causal orderings and describes projection to ancestral relations and causal-effect intervals.
